name: Life Research
source: Indonesian Visual Novel that tells people who live in a mysterious world with their problems in the past that made them thrown into that world. A student is trying to find the true meaning and meaning of life in a school in the world. Those who are thrown into the world are the ones who are trapped in suffering until they die and then are put in a world they call "the world after death". Nor is a student who does a study that he calls "live research" to help other schoolchildren feel the happiness and fulfill their dreams while still alive. Life in the world is not much different from life in the real world in general but in fact the inhabitants are the people who died in suffering during their lifetime. The period of life in the world is very short because after three years of being there the person will disappear and rest quietly waiting for fate to lead to heaven or to hell.
translation:
一部印度尼西亚语视觉小说，讲述一群生活在神秘世界中的人。他们因过去的种种问题被抛入这个世界。一名学生试图在这里的学校寻找生命的真正意义。

被抛入这个世界的人，都是生前被痛苦困住、最终死去的人，然后被送入他们称为“死后世界”的地方。还有一名学生开展名为“生命研究”的课题，帮助其他学生在活着时感受幸福、实现梦想。

这个世界的生活与现实世界并没有太大区别，但居民其实都是生前在痛苦中死去的人。在这里的生命十分短暂：三年后，人就会消失，静静等待命运把自己引向天堂或地狱。
